'''Dursa Conegan''' was a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] during the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Conegan operated in a [[mission group]] that was based in the [[Jaemus system/Legends|Jaemus system]].

==Biography==
At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Conegan received a report from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]]. The report briefed the colonel on [[Operation Death-Hunter]], a secret Imperial project based in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Madine had contacted Conegan because one of his [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] spies had filed a report that a large order of [[Tech 4 PDV]]s with connections to the Death-Hunter project was being sent to the [[Jaemus shipyards]]. Madine wished for Conegan to assemble a team to investigate the shipyards and pinpoint the location of the project.<ref name="DH" />

However, Madine clarified the report by explaining that the source of the information, the [[Spy/Legends|spy]] known as "[[Tigress]]," had broken off contact with [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] for a time before re-establishing contact. The troubling thing was that after this incident, the accuracy of the spy's reports dropped by 20%. Due to this, Madine warned Conegan that the Death-Hunter project might just be a ruse by a double agent. The truth of the Imperial project was eventually revealed by Conegan's team.<ref name="DH" />
